name: io.github.bosmdavid-gif/dropthehassle
description: Domains, static hosting, DNS and email forwarding. Publish with your AI. It never spends money.
title: DropTheHassle

environmentVariables.name: DTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your DropTheHassle account token from the dashboard. The agent uses it to publish and manage. It cannot spend money.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer dth_... token from dropthehassle.com (menu > Connect your AI). Optional for scanning.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show which DropTheHassle account the token belongs to.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List the sites on your account with their live links and status.

tools.name: search_domain
tools.description: Check whether a domain is available and what it would cost. Read-only. It never buys.

tools.name: deploy_site
tools.description: Put a static site online on a free link, or update a site you already have.

tools.name: point_domain
tools.description: Move a domain already on your account onto one of your sites. Does not buy, does not edit DNS elsewhere.

tools.name: choose_link
tools.description: Rename a site's free link. The old link redirects. Call only after the owner agrees.

tools.name: set_backend
tools.description: Link an HTTPS backend you host elsewhere behind your domain, for API paths or the whole site.

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Return a payment link the human opens and pays. The agent cannot pay it.

tools.name: site_of_the_day_badge
tools.description: Return the one line to paste for a Site of the day, week, month or year award. Read-only.

tools.name: award_readiness
tools.description: Checklist for a site on this account: favicon, share image, title, mobile viewport, page weight, custom domain and https. Read-only.
